Please wait while service software performs the following operations:
- unlock and push out the wash/waste drawer
- push out the lysis/diluent drawer
- unlocks all aspiration arms and waste dispense caps of liquid waste containers 1,2 and 3
Please perform the following operations:
- unload all wash reagent containers and close the wash reagent aspiration arms
- unload, empty and load the liquid waste containers 1,2 and 3, and close the waste dispense caps
- unload all diluent and lysis reagent bottles and close the aspiration arms
- keep the drawers open
Please wait while the service software performs following operations:
- unlock and push out the wash/waste drawer
- push out the lysis/diluent drawer
- unlocks all aspiration arms and waste dispense caps of liquid waste containers 2 and 3
Please perform the following operations:
- unload all wash reagent containers and close the wash reagent aspiration arms
- load empty liquid waste containers 2 and 3, and close the waste dispense caps
- unload all diluent and lysis reagent bottles and close the aspiration arms
- keep the drawers open
After lysis position 1 is unlocked, please load a full lysis reagent bottle and close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Lysis 1 to Waste 1 Via Degassing Pump

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while 200 ml is transferred from the lysis reagent bottle 1 to the liquid waste position 1 via degassing pump (via S10 - S12 - V4 - V6 - S22 - Degassing Pump - S23 - V11 - S35 - S38)...
Service Software will now unlock the lysis reagent bottle 1 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 1 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the lysis reagent bottle 1 and the liquid waste container 1 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from lysis reagent bottle 1 to liquid waste container 1 (approx. 200 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load it back on the liquid waste container on position 1 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the lysis position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Lysis 1 to Waste 2 Via Degassing Pump

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while 200 ml is transferred from the lysis reagent bottle 1 to the liquid waste position 2 via degassing pump (via S10 - S12 - V4 - V6 - S22 - Degassing Pump - S23 - V12 - S36 - S39)...
Service Software will now unlock the lysis reagent bottle 1 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 2 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the lysis reagent bottle 1 and the liquid waste container 2 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from lysis reagent bottle 1 to liquid waste container 2 (approx. 200 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load it back on the liquid waste container on position 2 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the lysis position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
After lysis position 2 is unlocked, please load a full lysis reagent bottle and close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Lysis 2 To Waste 1 Via Wash Station

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while 200 ml is transferred from the lysis reagent bottle 2 to the liquid waste container 1 via the wash station (via S11 - S13 - V4 - V6- S14 - Reagent Head - Wash Station - S26 - Reagent Wash Pump - S27 - V9 - S28 - V11 - S35 - S38)...
Service Software will now unlock the lysis reagent bottle 2 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 1 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the lysis reagent bottle 2 and the liquid waste container 1 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from lysis reagent bottle 2 to liquid waste container 1 (approx. 200 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load it back on the liquid waste container on position 1 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the lysis position 2
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Lysis 2 To Waste 2 Via Wash Station

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while 200 ml is transferred from the lysis reagent bottle 2 to the liquid waste container 2 via the wash station (via S11 - S13 - V4 - V6- S14 - Reagent Head - Wash Station - S26 - Reagent Wash Pump - S27 - V9 - S28 - V12 - S36 - S39)...
Service Software will now unlock the lysis reagent bottle 2 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 2 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:

- verify that liquid has been transferred from lysis reagent bottle 2 to liquid waste container 2 (approx. 200 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load it back on the liquid waste container on position 2 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the lysis position 2
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
After diluent position 1 is unlocked, please load a full diluent reagent bottle and close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Diluent 1 To Waste 1 Via Degassing Pump

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while 200 ml from the diluent reagent bottle 1 is transferred to the liquid waste container 1 via degassing pump (via S15 - S18 - V5 - V8 - S22 - Degassing Pump - S23 - V11 - S35 - S38)...
Service Software will now unlock the diluent reagent bottle 1 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 1 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the diluent reagent bottle 1 and the liquid waste container 1 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from diluent reagent bottle 1 to liquid waste container 1 (approx. 200 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load the liquid waste container on position 1 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the diluent position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Diluent 1 To Waste 2 Via Degassing Pump

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while 200 ml from the diluent reagent bottle 1 is transferred to the liquid waste container 2 via degassing pump (via S15 - S18 - V5 - V8 - S22 - Degassing Pump - S23 - V12 - S36 - S39)...
Service Software will now unlock the diluent reagent bottle 1 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 2 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the diluent reagent bottle 1 and the liquid waste container 2 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from diluent reagent bottle 1 to liquid waste container 2 (approx. 200 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load the liquid waste container on position 2 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the diluent position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
After diluent position 2 is unlocked, please load a full diluent reagent bottle and close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Diluent 2 To Waste 2 Via Wash Station

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while the service software transfers 200 ml from the diluent bottle reagent 2 to the liquid waste container 2 via wash reagent station and liquid waste station 1 (via S15 - S18 - V5 - V8 - S19 - ReagentHead - WashStation - S26 - ReagentWashPump - S27 - V9 - V10 - S33 - S29 - ProcessWastePump - S30 - V12 - S36 - S39)...
Service Software will now unlock the diluent reagent bottle 2 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 2 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the diluent reagent bottle 2 and the liquid waste container 2 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from diluent reagent bottle 2 to liquid waste container 2 (approx. 200 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load the liquid waste container on position 2 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the diluent position 2
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
Service software will now unlock the waste dispense caps of the liquid waste containers 1 and 3.
Please unload the liquid waste containers when the dripping has stopped.
Verify and confirm there is no liquid present in the liquid waste containers.
Then load the liquid waste containers back on the respective positions and close the waste dispense caps.
Service software will now unlock the waste dispense cap of the liquid waste container 3.
Please unload the liquid waste container when the dripping has stopped.
Verify and confirm there is no liquid present in the liquid waste container.
Then load the liquid waste container back on the respective position and close the waste dispense cap.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Wash Reagent Container 2 to Liquid Waste Container

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: After wash reagent position 2 is unlocked, please load a full wash reagent container, close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Wash 2 To Waste 1 Via Reservoir

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while the service software fills the wash reagent reservoir from the wash reagent container 2 until full (via S2 - S5 - V1 - S7 - Wash Buffer Pump - S8) and empties the wash reagent reservoir into liquid waste container 1 (via S21 - V7 - S22 - Degassing Pump - S23 - V11 - S35 - S38)...
Service Software will now unlock the wash reagent container 2 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 1 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the wash reagent container 2 and the liquid waste container 1 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from wash reagent container 2 to liquid waste container 1 (approx. 850 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container and load the liquid waste container on position 1 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the wash reagent container 2
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Wash 2 To Waste 2 Via Reservoir

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while the service software fills the wash reagent reservoir from the wash reagent container 2 until full (via S1 - S4 - V1 - S7 - Wash Buffer Pump - S8) and empties the wash reagent reservoir into liquid waste container 2 (via S21 - V7 - S22 - Degassing Pump - S23 - V12 - S36 - S39)...
Service Software will now unlock the wash reagent container 2 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 2 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the wash reagent container 2 and the liquid waste container 2 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from wash reagent container 2 to liquid waste container 2 (approx. 850 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container and load the liquid waste container on position 2 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the wash reagent container 2
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
Service Software will now unlock the wash reagent position 3.
Afterwards, please load a full wash reagent container and close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Wash Reagent 3 To Waste 3 Via Reservoir

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while service software fills the wash reagent reservoir until full from the wash reagent container 3 (via S3 - S6 - V1 - S7 - Wash Buffer Pump - S8) and then empties it into liquid waste container 3 (S21 - V7 - S22 - Degassing Pump - S23 - V13 - S37 - S40)...

workflow:Description.base:Title: Unload Wash Reagent Container 3 and Waste Containers

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Service Software will now unlock the wash reagent container 3 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 3 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the wash reagent container 3 and the liquid waste container 3 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from wash reagent container 3 to liquid waste container 3 (approx. 850 ml)
- empty the liquid waste container, load it back on position 3 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the wash reagent container 3
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
Service software will now unlock the waste dispense caps of the liquid waste containers 1 and 2.
Please unload the liquid waste containers when the dripping has stopped.
Verify and confirm that there is no liquid present in the liquid waste containers.
Finally load the liquid waste containers back on the respective positions, close the waste dispense caps.
Service software will now unlock the waste dispense cap of the liquid waste container 2.
Please unload the liquid waste container when the dripping has stopped.
Verify and confirm that there is no liquid present in the liquid waste container.
Finally load the liquid waste container back on the respective position, close the waste dispense cap.
Service Software will now unlock the diluent position 1. Afterwards, please load a full diluent reagent bottle, close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Diluent 1 To Waste 1 Via Wash Station

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while service software transfers 200 ml from the diluent reagent bottle 1 to the liquid waste container 1 via wash station and liquid waste station 2 (via S15 - S18 - ReagentHead - WashStation - S26 - ReagentWashPump - S27 - V9 - V10 - S34 - S31 - ProcessWastePump - S32 - V11 - S35 - S38) by flushing the liquid waste station 2...
Service Software will now unlock the diluent reagent bottle 1 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 1 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the diluent reagent bottle 1 and the liquid waste container 1 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from diluent reagent bottle 1 to liquid waste container 1 (approx. 200ml)
- empty the liquid waste container and load the liquid waste container on position 1 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the diluent position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Diluent 1 To Waste 2 Via Wash Station

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while service software transfers 200 ml from the diluent reagent bottle 1 to the liquid waste container 2 via wash station and liquid waste station 2 (via S15 - S18 - ReagentHead - WashStation - S26 - ReagentWashPump - S27 - V9 - V10 - S34 - S31 - ProcessWastePump - S32 - V12 - S36 - S39) by flushing the liquid waste station 2...
Service Software will now unlock the diluent reagent bottle 1 aspiration arm and the liquid waste container 2 waste dispense cap.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- unload the diluent reagent bottle 1 and the liquid waste container 2 (once the dripping has stopped)
- verify that liquid has been transferred from diluent reagent bottle 1 to liquid waste container 2 (approx. 200ml)
- empty the liquid waste container and load the liquid waste container on position 2 and close the waste dispense cap
- close the aspiration arm on the diluent position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
Service software will now unlock the waste dispense caps of the liquid waste containers 2 and 3.
Afterwards, when the dripping has stopped, unload the liquid waste containers.
Then verify and confirm there is no liquid present in liquid waste containers 2 and 3, load the liquid waste containers 2 and 3 respectively on positions 2 and 3 and close the waste dispense caps.
Service Software will now unlock the diluent position 1. Afterwards, please load a full diluent reagent bottle and close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Diluent 1 To Overflow Via Wash Station

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while service software transfers 300 ml from the diluent reagent bottle 1 to the waste station (via S15 - S18 - V5 - V8 - S19 - ReagentHead - WashStation - S41) by washing the reagent transfer head needles without draining...
Service Software will now unlock the diluent reagent bottle 1 aspiration arm.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- once the dripping has stopped, unload the diluent reagent bottle 1 and the overflow bottle
- verify that liquid has been transferred from diluent reagent bottle 1 to overflow bottle (approx. 175ml)
- empty the overflow bottle and load it back
- close the aspiration arm on the diluent position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
Service software will now unlock the waste dispense caps of the liquid waste containers 1, 2 and 3.
Afterwards, when the dripping has stopped, unload the liquid waste containers.
Verify and confirm that there is no liquid present in the liquid waste containers.
Load the liquid waste containers back on the respective positions and close the waste dispense caps.
Service software will now unlock the waste dispense caps of the liquid waste containers 2 and 3.
Afterwards, when the dripping has stopped, unload the liquid waste containers.
Verify and confirm that there is no liquid present in the liquid waste containers.
Load the liquid waste containers back on the respective positions and close the waste dispense caps.
Service Software will now unlock the wash reagent position 1. Afterwards, please load a full wash reagent container, close the aspiration arm.

workflow:Description.base:Title: Transfer Wash Reagent 1 to Overflow via Reservoir and Relief Valve

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while service software transfers 1200 ml from the wash reagent container 1 and overfills the wash reagent reservoir (via S1 - S4 - S7 - Wash Buffer Pump - S8 - S24 - S25). The excess liquid is transferred to the overflow bottle (via S9 - ReagentHead - WashStation - S41).
Service software will now unlock the wash reagent 1 aspiration arm.
Afterwards, please perform the following operations:
- once the dripping has stopped, unload the wash reagent 1 and the overflow bottle
- verify that liquid has been transferred from wash reagent 1 to overflow bottle (approx. 200ml)
- empty the overflow bottle and load it back
- close the aspiration arm on the wash reagent position 1
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully
Please wait while processing transfer heads are parked...
The downholders of the liquid waste stations and the tip rack park positions will now be opened.
Afterwards, please remove the waste inserts and the tip racks and press 'Next'...
Please wait while service software drains the wash station to liquid waste container 2...
Please perform the following actions:
- pour approximately 200 ml of wash reagent into the overflow openings of liquid waste stations 1 and 2
- verify visually that the liquid flows from liquid waste station 1 and 2 to the overflow bottle
- empty the overflow bottle and load it back
- confirm that the liquid was transferred successfully

workflow:Description.base:Title: Drain Wash and Liquid Waste Stations

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Please wait while service software drains the wash and liquid waste stations...
Service software will now unlock the cap of liquid waste container 2. Please unload and empty it, load it back and close its cap.
Please visually verify the tightness of connector S46 and the absence of droplets on the pump and valve block from the rear of the instrument.
Confirm if successful.
Consult the “Fluid System Overview” (service documentation) for further information.
Please close the wash/waste drawer and the lysis/diluent drawer and press 'Next'...
Please wait while the processing transfer heads are parked...
Please wait while downholders are opened...
Cleaning up service check resources...
